data.long_meaning: Sidharth is a compound name made up of two Sanskrit words: 'sidh' which means 'auspicious' or 'accomplished' and 'arth' which means 'goal' or 'purpose'. Together, the name Sidharth signifies one who has achieved their goal or purpose in life with great success. The name Sidhart carries the meaning “Auspicious, Successful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sidhart usually hope their child will grow to embody auspicious, successful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Sidharth is also the name of the 24th Jain Tirthankara and the historical Buddha Siddhartha Gautama. It is believed that a person named Sidharth is blessed with great wisdom and intelligence, and is able to overcome obstacles with courage and determination.

According to the Mahavamsa, an ancient Pali text, Siddharth Gautama, who later became the Buddha, was born in Lumbini, Nepal, in the year 563 BCE. Sidharth is often mentioned in various Hindu scriptures and literary works as a symbol of achieving one's goals through perseverance, determination, and hard work.
